subject: Re: Accelerator cohort promo credits — activation & guardrails
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@accelerateco.io>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Josh Patel <josh.patel@cloudlaunch.io>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Accelerator cohort promo credits — activation request

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the chat this week. We're excited to move forward with Redwood for the next accelerator cohort (Dec intake). Can you confirm the promotional credit allocation we discussed and the activation workflow? Specifically we need:
- Confirmed credit amount that can be applied per cohort (we estimated ~$10k/customer for 8 customers)
- Start/expiration dates and whether the voucher can be staged (e.g., 60/30/30 split)
- Any usage caps or reporting requirements from your side
- Expected lead time for voucher delivery and marketplace listing (our onboarding team needs at least 7 business days)

I've attached the cohort roster and our rough usage estimates. Happy to jump on a short call if helpful.

Attachments: AccelerateCo_Cohort_Terms_v3.pdf (agreement draft), usage_estimates_Q4.csv

Best,
Elena Morales
Partnerships Lead, AccelerateCo
elena@accelerateco.io
+1 415-555-0189

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@accelerateco.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Accelerator cohort promo credits — activation request

Elena — thanks for the detail and the roster. We're aligned to push this through; below is a proposed activation plan and the items we need to finalize.

Plan (provisional):
- Promo credit: $80,000 total, issued as a single voucher tied to the AccelerateCo cohort (we can discuss staged redemption but vouchers are simplest minted as one code)
- Default duration: 90 days from activation; can consider a one-time extension request at the end of the 90-day period
- Usage caps: per-tenant soft cap at first 60 days to prevent large one-off consumption — we'll surface usage weekly to your ops team
- Delivery: voucher code + onboarding playbook within 5 business days after approvals and signed terms

Action items for AccelerateCo:
1) Sign the attached terms (AccelerateCo_Cohort_Terms_v3.pdf) and return by EOD Tue so Finance can schedule the voucher issuance.
2) Complete and return usage_estimates_Q4.csv (you already attached — thanks) and the cohort-onboarding-checklist.xlsx (attached).

Internal owners: Ben (partnerships approval), Tessa (finance/voucher issuance), Soojin (partner ops activation). Ben/Tessa — can you confirm approvals and any billing prerequisites?

If you'd like the voucher staged (e.g., 60/30/30), note this will require a split of the total allocation into 3 separate voucher codes and an extra bookkeeping step by finance (possible but adds 3–4 business days).

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Attachments: cohort-onboarding-checklist.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Elena Morales <elena@accelerateco.io>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Accelerator cohort promo credits — activation request

Marissa — approving in principle for $80k total for the cohort, subject to the following guardrails:
- Limit per tenant: $12k redemption soft cap for first 60 days; requests beyond that we review weekly
- Data/compliance: confirm all cohort tenants are okay with US-region processing (Elena, can you confirm?)
- Marketplace listing: partner-facing offer must be live before voucher activation; Ops to confirm timing

Soojin — can you validate that Partner Ops has the onboarding bandwidth week-of-Nov 29? If not, we should push the activation window and notify AccelerateCo.

Tessa — please confirm the finance checklist required to create a cohort voucher (PO? signed terms?), and whether we can do a staged issuance if AccelerateCo requests it.

Thanks — Ben

From: Elena Morales <elena@accelerateco.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Josh Patel <josh.patel@cloudlaunch.io>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Accelerator cohort promo credits — activation request

Thanks Marissa and Ben — this is helpful. A couple follow-ups from our side:
1) Start date: our preferred cohort kickoff is Dec 6. That gives us two weeks of onboarding prep. Can the voucher be active Dec 6?
2) Duration: is Redwood open to a 120-day window instead of 90? A number of our participants need more runway to integrate and we'd like to avoid forcing early expiration exceptions.
3) Staging: We'd prefer a tiered/ staged redemption (60/30/30) to encourage initial trials and reserve credit for later conversions. If staged costs an extra 3–4 days, that's acceptable.

I've attached a slightly updated usage_estimates_Q4.csv with one tenant flagged for higher token usage — that might push them near the per-tenant cap. Let us know how you'd prefer we manage that.

Elena

Subject: Re: Accelerator cohort promo credits — activation & guardrails (approved)

Elena — good news. We can accommodate a 120-day window for this cohort on a one-time basis, conditional on the following and subject to final sign-off from Finance (Tessa):

Conditions / activation playbook:
1) Signed terms returned (AccelerateCo_Cohort_Terms_v3.pdf) and an internal PO for accounting.
2) Staged issuance accepted — we'll create 3 voucher codes (60/30/30 split). Finance will need an extra 3 business days to mint the second/third codes.
3) Per-tenant soft cap: $12k for first 60 days; if any tenant hits >90% of that, notify partner-ops@redwood.ai for joint review.
4) Marketplace listing or partner offer live before first voucher activation. Soojin — please confirm listing status and bandwidth for Dec 6 activation.
5) Reporting: AccelerateCo to share weekly usage totals; Redwood will send aggregated cohort consumption every Monday morning.

Next steps (owners):
- Elena: return signed terms + confirm PO (AccelerateCo) — items in attachments
- Tessa/Finance: mint first voucher after signed terms; schedule follow-up 3 business days for additional codes
- Soojin/Partner Ops: confirm marketplace listing and schedule onboarding week of Nov 29 if possible

Once those are done, finance will issue voucher ID and we'll share redemption instructions and the onboarding checklist. Tagging finance alias so they pick this up.

Marissa Cole
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
